```{=html}
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Simulador de Amostragem</title>
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <style>
        body { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; background-color: #f1f5f9; }
        #canvas-container { position: relative; width: 100%; max-width: 500px; margin: 0 auto; }
        canvas { 
            width: 100%; 
            height: auto; 
            background: #ffffff; 
            box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1);
            border-radius: 0.75rem;
            display: block;
        }
        .stat-card { transition: all 0.3s ease; }
        .stat-card.active { border-color: #ef4444; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2); }
    </style>
</head>
<body class="text-slate-800 min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center p-4 sm:p-6">

    <div class="max-w-5xl w-full">
        <!-- Stats Panel -->
        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4 mb-6">
            <div class="stat-card bg-white p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm flex flex-col items-center">
                <span class="text-sm text-slate-500 font-medium uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Método Atual</span>
                <span id="ui-method" class="text-lg font-bold text-slate-700">Nenhum</span>
            </div>
            <div class="stat-card bg-white p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm flex flex-col items-center">
                <span class="text-sm text-slate-500 font-medium uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Amostras Coletadas</span>
                <span class="text-2xl font-bold text-indigo-600"><span id="ui-samples">0</span> / 40</span>
            </div>
            <div class="stat-card bg-white p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm flex flex-col items-center">
                <span class="text-sm text-slate-500 font-medium uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Distância (Custo)</span>
                <span class="text-2xl font-bold text-red-600"><span id="ui-distance">0</span> km</span>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Canvas -->
        <div id="canvas-container" class="mb-2">
            <canvas id="mapCanvas" width="900" height="600"></canvas>
        </div>

        <!-- Controls -->
        <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-center gap-4">
            <button id="btn-simples" class="px-3 py-3 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-white font-semibold rounded-lg shadow-md transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed">
                Aleatória Simples
            </button>
            <button id="btn-conglomerado" class="px-3 py-3 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-semibold rounded-lg shadow-md transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed">
                Conglomerados
            </button>
        </div>
        
        <!-- Legend -->
        <div class="mt-8 flex justify-center items-center gap-6 text-sm text-slate-600">
            <!-- A legenda da população não selecionada foi removida para manter a coerência visual -->
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                <div class="w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-yellow-500 border border-yellow-700"></div> Amostra Coletada
            </div>
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                <div class="w-6 h-1 bg-red-500"></div> Trajeto do Pesquisador
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        const canvas = document.getElementById('mapCanvas');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        
        // UI Elements
        const uiMethod = document.getElementById('ui-method');
        const uiSamples = document.getElementById('ui-samples');
        const uiDistance = document.getElementById('ui-distance');
        const btnSimples = document.getElementById('btn-simples');
        const btnConglomerado = document.getElementById('btn-conglomerado');

        // Configurações do Mapa (Grid e População)
        const cols = 8;
        const rows = 6;
        const blockW = canvas.width / cols;
        const blockH = canvas.height / rows;
        const popPerBlock = 12; // População em cada bloco
        const targetSamples = 40;
        
        let blocks = [];
        let population = [];
        
        // Estado da Animação
        let isAnimating = false;
        let animationReq;
        let path = [];
        let currentPathIdx = 0;
        let currentPos = {x: 0, y: 0};
        let accumulatedDistance = 0;
        let collectedSamples = 0;
        let animSpeed = 12; // Pixels por frame de deslocamento
        let pathPointsDrawn = []; // Para desenhar as linhas permanentemente

        // Inicialização dos Dados
        function initData() {
            blocks = [];
            population = [];
            for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
                for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
                    const block = { id: `${c}-${r}`, col: c, row: r, points: [] };
                    
                    // Margem dentro do bloco para as ruas
                    const marginX = blockW * 0.15;
                    const marginY = blockH * 0.15;
                    
                    for (let i = 0; i < popPerBlock; i++) {
                        const pt = {
                            x: c * blockW + marginX + Math.random() * (blockW - marginX * 2),
                            y: r * blockH + marginY + Math.random() * (blockH - marginY * 2),
                            blockId: block.id,
                            selected: false
                        };
                        block.points.push(pt);
                        population.push(pt);
                    }
                    blocks.push(block);
                }
            }
        }

        // Desenhar Fundo Estático (Ruas e Mapa)
        function drawBackground() {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

            // Desenhar Ruas (Grid)
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#e2e8f0';
            ctx.lineWidth = 4;
            
            // Avenidas mais grossas a cada 2 blocos
            for (let c = 0; c <= cols; c++) {
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.lineWidth = (c % 2 === 0) ? 8 : 4;
                ctx.strokeStyle = (c % 2 === 0) ? '#cbd5e1' : '#f1f5f9';
                ctx.moveTo(c * blockW, 0);
                ctx.lineTo(c * blockW, canvas.height);
                ctx.stroke();
            }
            
            for (let r = 0; r <= rows; r++) {
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.lineWidth = (r % 2 === 0) ? 8 : 4;
                ctx.strokeStyle = (r % 2 === 0) ? '#cbd5e1' : '#f1f5f9';
                ctx.moveTo(0, r * blockH);
                ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, r * blockH);
                ctx.stroke();
            }
            
            // O código que desenhava a população não selecionada foi removido daqui
        }

        // Desenhar Estado Atual (Linhas e Pontos Selecionados)
        function drawState() {
            drawBackground();

            // Desenhar trajeto já percorrido
            if (pathPointsDrawn.length > 0) {
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4)'; // Red claro e transparente para rastros velhos
                ctx.lineWidth = 2;
                ctx.moveTo(pathPointsDrawn[0].x, pathPointsDrawn[0].y);
                for (let i = 1; i < pathPointsDrawn.length; i++) {
                    ctx.lineTo(pathPointsDrawn[i].x, pathPointsDrawn[i].y);
                }
                // Conectar ao ponto atual em animação
                if (isAnimating) {
                    ctx.lineTo(currentPos.x, currentPos.y);
                }
                ctx.stroke();
            }

            // Destacar Pontos Coletados
            population.forEach(pt => {
                if(pt.selected) {
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(pt.x, pt.y, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#eab308'; // Amarelo
                    ctx.fill();
                    ctx.strokeStyle = '#a16207';
                    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
                    ctx.stroke();
                }
            });

            // Ponto de viagem do pesquisador
            if (isAnimating) {
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(currentPos.x, currentPos.y, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fillStyle = '#ef4444'; // Red-500
                ctx.fill();
            }
        }

        // Helper: Algoritmo Guloso de Vendedor Viajante (Nearest Neighbor)
        function nearestNeighborRoute(pointsArray, startPoint) {
            let unvisited = [...pointsArray];
            let route = [];
            let current = startPoint ? startPoint : unvisited[0];
            
            if(startPoint) {
                unvisited = unvisited.filter(p => p !== startPoint);
            } else {
                unvisited.shift();
            }
            route.push(current);

            while (unvisited.length > 0) {
                let nearest = null;
                let minDist = Infinity;
                
                for (let pt of unvisited) {
                    let d = Math.hypot(pt.x - current.x, pt.y - current.y);
                    if (d < minDist) {
                        minDist = d;
                        nearest = pt;
                    }
                }
                
                route.push(nearest);
                unvisited = unvisited.filter(p => p !== nearest);
                current = nearest;
            }
            return route;
        }

        // Lógica de Amostragem Simples
        function prepareSimpleSampling() {
            // Escolhe 40 aleatórios de toda a população
            let shuffled = [...population].sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random());
            let selected = shuffled.slice(0, targetSamples);
            
            // O pesquisador tenta otimizar levemente o caminho para não ser caótico ao extremo (Nearest Neighbor global)
            // Mesmo com NN, o custo será alto porque os pontos estão espalhados
            return nearestNeighborRoute(selected);
        }

        // Lógica de Amostragem por Conglomerados
        function prepareClusterSampling() {
            // Passo 1: Escolhe 4 blocos aleatórios
            let numClusters = 4;
            let samplesPerCluster = targetSamples / numClusters; // 10 por bloco
            
            let shuffledBlocks = [...blocks].sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random());
            let selectedBlocks = shuffledBlocks.slice(0, numClusters);
            
            let finalRoute = [];
            
            // Ordena os blocos por proximidade do centro ou ordem para evitar zigue-zague absurdo entre blocos
            selectedBlocks.sort((a,b) => a.col - b.col);

            let lastPoint = null;

            // Passo 2: Dentro de cada bloco escolhido, escolhe 10 aleatórios
            for (let block of selectedBlocks) {
                let shuffledPts = [...block.points].sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random());
                let clusterSamples = shuffledPts.slice(0, samplesPerCluster);
                
                // Organiza rota local do bloco
                let localRoute = nearestNeighborRoute(clusterSamples, clusterSamples[0]);
                
                finalRoute = finalRoute.concat(localRoute);
            }
            return finalRoute;
        }

        // Iniciar Animação
        function startSimulation(type) {
            if (isAnimating) cancelAnimationFrame(animationReq);
            
            // Resetar estados
            population.forEach(p => p.selected = false);
            pathPointsDrawn = [];
            accumulatedDistance = 0;
            collectedSamples = 0;
            currentPathIdx = 0;
            uiDistance.textContent = "0";
            uiSamples.textContent = "0";
            
            btnSimples.disabled = true;
            btnConglomerado.disabled = true;
            isAnimating = true;

            if (type === 'simples') {
                uiMethod.textContent = 'Aleatória Simples';
                path = prepareSimpleSampling();
            } else {
                uiMethod.textContent = 'Conglomerados';
                path = prepareClusterSampling();
            }

            // Ponto de partida
            currentPos = { x: path[0].x, y: path[0].y };
            pathPointsDrawn.push(path[0]);
            path[0].selected = true;
            collectedSamples++;
            uiSamples.textContent = collectedSamples;

            animate();
        }

        // Loop de Animação
        function animate() {
            if (currentPathIdx >= path.length - 1) {
                // Fim da Animação
                isAnimating = false;
                btnSimples.disabled = false;
                btnConglomerado.disabled = false;
                drawState();
                return;
            }

            let target = path[currentPathIdx + 1];
            let dx = target.x - currentPos.x;
            let dy = target.y - currentPos.y;
            let distToTarget = Math.hypot(dx, dy);

            if (distToTarget <= animSpeed) {
                // Chegou no alvo
                currentPos.x = target.x;
                currentPos.y = target.y;
                accumulatedDistance += distToTarget;
                
                pathPointsDrawn.push(target);
                target.selected = true;
                collectedSamples++;
                uiSamples.textContent = collectedSamples;
                
                currentPathIdx++;
                
                // Atualizar Distancia na UI (Mapeamento fictício pixels -> km)
                uiDistance.textContent = (accumulatedDistance / 20).toFixed(1);
            } else {
                // Mover em direção ao alvo
                let vx = (dx / distToTarget) * animSpeed;
                let vy = (dy / distToTarget) * animSpeed;
                currentPos.x += vx;
                currentPos.y += vy;
                accumulatedDistance += animSpeed;
                
                uiDistance.textContent = (accumulatedDistance / 20).toFixed(1);
            }

            drawState();
            animationReq = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
        }

        // Eventos de Botões
        btnSimples.addEventListener('click', () => startSimulation('simples'));
        btnConglomerado.addEventListener('click', () => startSimulation('conglomerado'));

        // Boot
        window.onload = () => {
            initData();
            drawState();
        };

    </script>
</body>
```
